newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Manuel to meet market players Feb 20.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Manuel to meet market players Feb 20.

text.p: South African Finance Minister Trevor Manuel will deliver two presentations to local financial institutions on February 20, his spokeswoman said on Tuesday.
The minister will use the meetings -- one in Johannesburg in the morning and one in Cape Town in the afternoon -- to explain government policies and give an outlook for 1997.
"It's a way to reach a wider audience...and give a range of financial institutions fair access to information," the spokeswoman said.
The meetings, which will also be open to the media, come shortly before the March 12 budget for 1997/98 and a week after Manuel presents his adjustment budget for 1996/97.
There has been speculation that Manuel might be moved from his current position, although this has been denied by government officials.
